entities.name: dns_event
entities.caption: DNS Event
entities.description: DNS queries and responses with threat detection capabilities

attributes.name: query_hostname
attributes.caption: Query Hostname
attributes.description: The fully qualified domain name being queried
attributes.security_context: Critical for detecting DGA domains, DNS tunneling, and C2 beaconing. Check for entropy, length, and character patterns.

attributes.name: query_type
attributes.caption: Query Type
attributes.security_context: TXT and NULL records are commonly abused for DNS tunneling. AAAA queries may indicate IPv6 C2 channels.

attributes.name: source_ip
attributes.caption: Source IP
attributes.description: IP address of the client making the DNS query
attributes.security_context: Track query patterns per source IP to detect compromised hosts, DGA activity, and scanning behavior.

attributes.name: source_port
attributes.caption: Source Port
attributes.description: Source port number of the DNS query

attributes.name: response_code
attributes.caption: Response Code
attributes.description: DNS response code (NOERROR, NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL, etc.)
attributes.security_context: High NXDOMAIN rates indicate DGA activity. SERVFAIL may indicate DNS infrastructure issues or attacks.

attributes.name: action
attributes.caption: Action
attributes.description: Action taken on the DNS query (Allowed, Blocked, etc.)
attributes.security_context: Blocked queries indicate policy enforcement or threat prevention. Track blocked domains for IOC analysis.

attributes.name: cloud_provider
attributes.caption: Cloud Provider
attributes.description: Cloud service provider hosting the DNS infrastructure

attributes.name: cloud_region
attributes.caption: Cloud Region
attributes.description: Cloud region where the DNS query originated

attributes.name: event_time
attributes.caption: Event Time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DNS query occurred

query_templates.name: dns_tunneling_high_volume
query_templates.intent: Detect DNS tunneling by identifying hosts with unusually high query volumes
patterns: Show hosts with high DNS query volume
Which hosts are making too many DNS queries
query_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  source_ip,
  COUNT(*) as query_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT query_hostname) as unique_domains,
  AVG(LENGTH(query_hostname)) as avg_query_length
FROM dns_event
WHERE time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
GROUP BY source_ip
HAVING query_count > {{threshold}}
ORDER BY query_count DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

query_templates.name: dns_tunneling_long_queries
query_templates.intent: Detect DNS tunneling by finding unusually long DNS queries (data encoded in subdomain)
patterns: Show DNS queries with long hostnames
query_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  source_ip,
  query_hostname,
  LENGTH(query_hostname) as query_length,
  time
FROM dns_event
WHERE LENGTH(query_hostname) > {{min_length}}
  AND time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
ORDER BY query_length DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

query_templates.name: dns_txt_record_abuse
query_templates.intent: Detect potential DNS tunneling via TXT record queries
patterns: Which hosts are querying TXT records
query_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  source_ip,
  query_hostname,
  COUNT(*) as txt_query_count,
  MIN(time) as first_seen,
  MAX(time) as last_seen
FROM dns_event
WHERE query_type = 'TXT'
  AND time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
GROUP BY source_ip, query_hostname
HAVING txt_query_count > {{threshold}}
ORDER BY txt_query_count DESC

query_templates.name: dga_nxdomain_spike
query_templates.intent: Detect DGA activity by finding hosts with high NXDOMAIN response rates
patterns: Which hosts have failed DNS lookups
query_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  source_ip,
  COUNT(*) as total_queries,
  SUM(CASE WHEN response_code = 'NXDOMAIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nxdomain_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN response_code = 'NXDOMAIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as nxdomain_rate
FROM dns_event
WHERE time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
GROUP BY source_ip
HAVING nxdomain_rate > {{nxdomain_threshold}}
  AND total_queries > {{min_queries}}
ORDER BY nxdomain_count DESC
query_templates.mitre_technique: T1568.002 - Dynamic Resolution: Domain Generation Algorithms

query_templates.name: dga_random_domains
query_templates.intent: Find domains with high entropy (randomness) indicating DGA
query_templates.sql:
WITH domain_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    query_hostname,
    source_ip,
    COUNT(*) as query_count,
    LENGTH(query_hostname) as domain_length,
    LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(query_hostname, '[^0-9]', '')) as numeric_chars,
    LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(query_hostname, '[^a-z]', '')) as alpha_chars
  FROM dns_event
  WHERE time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
    AND LENGTH(query_hostname) > 10
  GROUP BY query_hostname, source_ip
)
SELECT *,
  ROUND(100.0 * numeric_chars / domain_length, 2) as numeric_ratio
FROM domain_stats
WHERE numeric_chars > domain_length * 0.3
  OR domain_length > {{max_normal_length}}
ORDER BY query_count DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}
query_templates.mitre_technique: T1568.002 - Dynamic Resolution: Domain Generation Algorithms

query_templates.name: fast_flux_detection
query_templates.intent: Detect fast flux DNS by finding domains resolving to many different IPs
patterns: Find domains with multiple IP addresses
query_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  query_hostname,
  COUNT(DISTINCT answers_rdata) as unique_ips,
  COUNT(*) as query_count,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT answers_rdata) as ip_addresses
FROM dns_event
WHERE time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  AND answers_rdata IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY query_hostname
HAVING unique_ips > {{ip_threshold}}
ORDER BY unique_ips DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}
query_templates.mitre_technique: T1568.001 - Dynamic Resolution: Fast Flux DNS

query_templates.name: c2_beaconing_regular_intervals
query_templates.intent: Detect C2 beaconing by finding DNS queries at regular time intervals
query_templates.sql:
WITH query_intervals AS (
  SELECT 
    source_ip,
    query_hostname,
    time,
    LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY source_ip, query_hostname ORDER BY time) as prev_time,
    DATEDIFF(second, LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY source_ip, query_hostname ORDER BY time), time) as interval_seconds
  FROM dns_event
  WHERE time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
)
SELECT 
  source_ip,
  query_hostname,
  COUNT(*) as beacon_count,
  AVG(interval_seconds) as avg_interval,
  STDDEV(interval_seconds) as interval_stddev,
  MIN(time) as first_seen,
  MAX(time) as last_seen
FROM query_intervals
WHERE interval_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY source_ip, query_hostname
HAVING beacon_count > {{min_beacons}}
  AND interval_stddev < avg_interval * {{jitter_threshold}}
ORDER BY beacon_count DESC

query_templates.name: ioc_domain_match
query_templates.intent: Match DNS queries against known malicious domains from threat intel
query_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  d.source_ip,
  d.query_hostname,
  d.time,
  d.action,
  t.threat_type,
  t.confidence,
  t.source as intel_source
FROM dns_event d
INNER JOIN threat_intel_ioc t 
  ON d.query_hostname = t.indicator
  OR d.query_hostname LIKE '%.' || t.indicator
WHERE d.time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  AND t.indicator_type = 'domain'
ORDER BY d.time DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

query_templates.name: blocked_dns_by_host
query_templates.intent: Find hosts with high rates of blocked DNS queries
query_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  source_ip,
  COUNT(*) as total_queries,
  SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'Blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as blocked_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'Blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as blocked_rate,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT query_hostname) FILTER (WHERE action = 'Blocked') as blocked_domains
FROM dns_event
WHERE time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
GROUP BY source_ip
HAVING blocked_count > {{min_blocked}}
ORDER BY blocked_count DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

query_templates.name: top_queried_domains
query_templates.intent: Show the most frequently queried domains
query_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  query_hostname,
  COUNT(*) as query_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) as unique_clients,
  MIN(time) as first_seen,
  MAX(time) as last_seen
FROM dns_event
WHERE time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
GROUP BY query_hostname
ORDER BY query_count DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

query_templates.name: dns_by_region
query_templates.intent: Show DNS query distribution by cloud region
query_templates.sql:
SELECT 
  cloud_region,
  COUNT(*) as query_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) as unique_clients,
  COUNT(DISTINCT query_hostname) as unique_domains
FROM dns_event
WHERE time >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
GROUP BY cloud_region
ORDER BY query_count DESC

query_templates.name: new_domains_first_seen
query_templates.intent: Find domains queried for the first time recently
query_templates.sql:
WITH domain_history AS (
  SELECT 
    query_hostname,
    MIN(time) as first_seen,
    COUNT(*) as total_queries
  FROM dns_event
  GROUP BY query_hostname
)
SELECT 
  query_hostname,
  first_seen,
  total_queries
FROM domain_history
WHERE first_seen >= DATEADD(hour, -{{hours}}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
ORDER BY first_seen DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

computed_fields.name: domain_entropy
computed_fields.description: Approximation of Shannon entropy - high values may indicate DGA
computed_fields.sql: LENGTH(query_hostname) - LENGTH(REPLACE(LOWER(query_hostname), 'a', '')) + LENGTH(query_hostname) - LENGTH(REPLACE(LOWER(query_hostname), 'e', '')) + LENGTH(query_hostname) - LENGTH(REPLACE(LOWER(query_hostname), 'i', '')) + LENGTH(query_hostname) - LENGTH(REPLACE(LOWER(query_hostname), 'o', '')) + LENGTH(query_hostname) - LENGTH(REPLACE(LOWER(query_hostname), 'u', ''))

computed_fields.name: subdomain_depth
computed_fields.description: Number of subdomain levels - deep nesting may indicate tunneling

computed_fields.name: query_length
computed_fields.description: Character length of hostname - long queries may indicate data encoding

computed_fields.name: is_numeric_heavy
computed_fields.description: True if hostname contains >40% numeric characters - DGA indicator
computed_fields.sql: CASE WHEN (LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(query_hostname, '[^0-9]', '')) * 1.0 / NULLIF(LENGTH(query_hostname), 0)) > 0.4 THEN true ELSE false END
